test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.**

The wedding gown / looked decently / despite being / studded with jewels.
solution:
The correct answer is **'looked decently'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**decently**" is an **adverb**, which is used to modify verbs or adjectives, but in the given sentence, it is used to modify the noun **"wedding gown".**
 
• This is incorrect as adverbs cannot modify nouns.
 
• To make the sentence grammatically correct, we can replace "**decently**" with an appropriate adjective such as "good", **"decent"**, or "nice".
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Therefore, the corrected sentence would be:** *The wedding gown **looked decent__** despite being studded with jewels.*
